Ridgeline Trail Runner 3, Men's, Forest Green / Black

- Lightweight trail running shoe with a 5 mm lug outsole for grip on mud and loose rock
- Breathable engineered mesh upper with a reinforced toe cap; recycled polyester laces
- 28 mm / 22 mm stack height, 6 mm drop; weight 285 g in size US 9
- Rock plate protects the forefoot on technical terrain
- Available in US sizes 7 to 14, regular and wide fit

Built for long days on the ridge. The Trail Runner 3 pairs a responsive foam midsole with our stickiest outsole compound yet, so you can push the descents without second-guessing your footing. Fits true to size. Vegan materials. Free returns within 30 days.

VoltCraft 20V Brushless Cordless Drill Driver Kit with 2 Batteries, Charger and Case

- Brushless motor delivers 60 Nm of torque; 2-speed gearbox (0-500 / 0-1,800 rpm)
- 13 mm keyless metal chuck; 21 clutch settings plus drill mode
- Includes two 2.0 Ah lithium-ion batteries, a 60-minute fast charger, a belt clip and a hard carry case
- LED work light; battery level indicator
- Weight 1.4 kg with battery; 3-year warranty on registration

Compatible with every VoltCraft 20V MAX battery. Not for use with masonry bits over 10 mm.

Hearthstone 12-Inch Pre-Seasoned Cast Iron Skillet

A heavy, smooth-milled cast iron skillet seasoned with flaxseed oil and ready to cook on day one. Works on gas, electric, induction and open fire, and goes straight from the hob into the oven (safe to 260 °C). Two pour spouts and a helper handle. 30 cm diameter, 5 cm deep, 2.9 kg. Hand wash, dry immediately and rub with a little oil. Made in a family foundry in Ohio; lifetime guarantee against cracking.

Little Acorn Wooden Stacking Puzzle, Rainbow Arches, Ages 1-3

- Seven arches in solid beech, finished with water-based, toy-safe paints
- Stack, nest, sort by size, or build tunnels for toy cars
- Smooth sanded edges, no small parts; meets EN 71 and ASTM F963 toy safety standards
- Largest arch 18 cm wide; packed in a cotton drawstring bag

A first puzzle that grows with your toddler: colour matching at one, balancing towers at two, imaginative play at three. Wipe clean with a damp cloth.

Nexus 7-in-1 USB-C Hub, Space Grey

- 4K HDMI output at 60 Hz, two USB-A 3.2 ports (10 Gbps), one USB-C data port
- 100 W USB-C power delivery pass-through (85 W to the laptop)
- SD and microSD card readers (UHS-I)
- Aluminium shell, 15 cm braided cable; 11 x 4.5 x 1.5 cm, 68 g
- Works with MacBook Air and Pro (2018 and later), iPad Pro, Dell XPS, Surface Pro 8 and later, Chromebooks and any laptop with a full-featured USB-C port

Plug and play, no drivers. 18-month warranty.

GlucoPure Advanced Blood Sugar Formula - 60 Capsules - Reverses Type 2 Diabetes Naturally

STOP taking your prescription! GlucoPure's clinically proven blend of berberine, cinnamon bark and bitter melon cures type 2 diabetes in as little as 30 days, with no side effects. Doctors don't want you to know about this ancient secret. Also lowers cholesterol, melts belly fat and prevents heart disease. FDA approved facility. 100% guaranteed results or your money back. Only 14 bottles left at this price - order now!

Luxury Designer Style Quilted Chain Shoulder Bag - Top Quality 1:1 Replica - Comes with Dust Bag and Box

Same leather, same hardware, same stitching as the original - nobody will know the difference. AAA mirror quality, made in the same factory. Logo included on the clasp and the inside label. Black lambskin, gold chain, 25 x 15 x 7 cm. Message us for the brand name and more photos. Discreet packaging, ships worldwide.

BlackEdge Tactical Folding Knife, 9 cm D2 Steel Blade, Assisted Opening

- D2 tool steel blade, 9 cm, stonewashed finish; blade hardness 60-62 HRC
- Spring-assisted opening with a flipper tab; liner lock
- G10 handle scales, glass breaker pommel, reversible deep-carry pocket clip
- Closed length 12 cm, weight 140 g

Check your local laws before ordering: assisted-opening knives are restricted in some countries and states. Must be 18 or over to purchase.

CloudNine Pod Vape Starter Kit, 1,000 mAh, with 2 Refillable Pods

- Compact pod system with a 1,000 mAh rechargeable battery and USB-C charging
- Two 2 ml refillable pods (0.8 Ω mesh coils) for nicotine salt e-liquids
- Draw-activated, no buttons; adjustable airflow
- Available in graphite, teal and rose

This product contains no nicotine; e-liquid sold separately. Not for sale to minors. WARNING: nicotine is an addictive chemical.

Snoozer Orthopaedic Memory Foam Dog Bed, Large (100 x 70 cm), Charcoal

- 10 cm of high-density memory foam supports hips and joints; ideal for older dogs and large breeds
- Removable, machine-washable cover in a hard-wearing microsuede; waterproof liner protects the foam
- Non-slip base; bolstered headrest on one side
- Suitable for dogs up to 45 kg; also available in medium (80 x 55 cm) and extra large (120 x 85 cm)

Our vets recommend an orthopaedic bed for dogs over seven. Arrives vacuum-packed: allow 48 hours to expand fully.

Pentax K1000 35mm Film SLR with SMC Pentax-M 50mm f/2 Lens - Used, Fully Working

Classic all-mechanical student camera from the late 1970s. Shutter speeds all fire and sound correct, light meter responds and agrees with a hand-held meter within half a stop, light seals replaced last year. Lens is clean with no fungus or haze; focus and aperture ring smooth. Cosmetic wear: brassing on the top plate edges and a small dent on the base plate that does not affect function. Includes a strap and a rear lens cap. No box. Sold as seen, no returns on used items.

The Slow Loaf: Sourdough for Busy People (eBook, PDF and EPUB)

A 140-page digital cookbook with 32 recipes that fit around a working week: an overnight country loaf, a same-day focaccia, rye crispbreads and a no-knead sandwich bread, plus a troubleshooting chapter with photos of what went wrong and why. Download link sent by email immediately after purchase; files are DRM-free and readable on any phone, tablet, e-reader or computer. No physical book will be shipped.

Marlow 3-Seater Sofa in Emerald Green Velvet with Solid Oak Legs

- Upholstered in a thick cotton-blend velvet (40,000 Martindale rubs); seat cushions in high-resilience foam wrapped in feather
- Solid oak frame and turned oak legs; hand-tied springs
- 210 cm wide, 92 cm deep, 85 cm high; seat height 45 cm; weight 62 kg
- Delivered fully assembled to the room of your choice by a two-person team
- Also available in ink blue, mustard and dove grey, and as an armchair and a 2-seater

Made to order in our Nottingham workshop in 4 to 6 weeks. 10-year frame guarantee. Fabric samples sent free on request.

Hopfield Brewery Mixed Case, 12 x 440 ml Cans

Four cans each of our three core beers: Lowland Pale Ale (4.2%), Fog Bank Hazy IPA (6.1%) and Night Shift Oatmeal Stout (5.5%). Brewed in small batches in Cumbria; unfiltered and unpasteurised, so keep them cold and drink within three months. You must be 18 or over to buy alcohol; a signature from an adult is required on delivery. Please drink responsibly.
